meta.title: Kinetic — Wood Workshop
meta.description: Kinetic is the wood workshop behind Wood Knots — handmade furniture and wood pieces, carved and painted to order.

home.title: Made by hand, built to last a lifetime.
home.lead: Tables, chairs, shelves and other wood pieces made in our own workshop — from choosing the timber to the final finish. Tell us what you need and we'll build it.
home.whatsappMessage: Hello Kinetic, I'd like to ask about your wood products.
home.featuredIntro: A few pieces fresh out of our workshop.
home.processIntro: Everything is made to order. Here's how it works:

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.body: Message us on WhatsApp: size, purpose, colours or example photos.

steps.title: Design & quote
steps.body: We help refine the design and give you a price and lead time.

steps.title: Made in the workshop
steps.body: The timber is chosen, carved, painted and finished by hand in our Bekasi workshop.

steps.title: Pick up or delivery
steps.body: Collect your piece at the workshop, or we'll help arrange delivery.

home.ctaBody: Tell us about it. We'd love to help make it real.
